g.text: PARALLEL PUMP STATION VER 1 · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
PARALLEL PUMP STATION — CAT-CRACKER FEED, T200 TO D-150
1. Flags: OTS design state — P-200A running, P-200B spare lined up (idle), FRC-100 AUTO 14 L/s, TIC-110 MAN 50 %.
2. Gas oil 870 kg/m3, 60 °C in T200. Pressures in bar g from the model heads (m of liquid); steam in bar g in the E-100 shell.
3. Suction and discharge block valves, check valves NRV-210/220, local gauges, drains, vents and trips: see P&ID PPS-PID-001.
4. Sizes: T200 Ø12 x 10 m, D-150 30 m3 (model); other symbols indicative.
